name: Ab wheel

lead: An ab wheel (ab roller) is a small wheel on an axle with handles on either side. The user kneels or stands, grips the handles and rolls the wheel forward until the body is extended, then pulls back.

It is used to train the abdominal wall and anti-extension strength of the trunk. In looksmaxxing it is promoted for visible abs, but visibility depends mainly on low body fat; the wheel builds the muscle underneath.

paras: As the wheel rolls out, the lever arm grows and the abdominal muscles must resist the spine arching toward extension, loading the rectus abdominis, obliques and deep core, with the lats and shoulders also working. Electromyography studies of similar rollout devices show high abdominal activity, although I could not find a peer-reviewed study of the standard kneeling rollout alone.

Lower-back sag, shoulder strain and wrist discomfort are the common problems, and the exercise is too hard for many beginners without partial range or a wall stop. People with back or shoulder issues should be careful. Marketing that the wheel flattens the stomach is unsupported: spot training does not reliably reduce fat from one area.

studies.title: Electromyographic analysis of traditional and nontraditional abdominal exercises: implications for rehabilitation and training
